sdrbench.name: SDRBench

excluded_fields.reason: zero value range; range-relative bound and PSNR undefined
zero value range; range-relative bound and PSNR undefined

sdrbench.timing_scope: native adapter operation including configuration/allocation; excludes input copy, file I/O, process startup, validation and final output destruction

ssim_rd.label: SSIM
ssim_rd.description: Median field SSIM versus combined bits/value.

ssim_loss_rd.label: 1 − SSIM
ssim_loss_rd.description: Median 1−SSIM versus combined bits/value; smaller is better.

pcc_rd.label: Pearson r
pcc_rd.description: Median Pearson correlation between original and reconstructed fields versus combined bits/value.

nrmse_rd.label: NRMSE
nrmse_rd.description: Median range-normalized RMSE versus combined bits/value. NRMSE and PSNR are mathematically related.

spectral_l1_rd.label: Relative spectral power L1
spectral_l1_rd.description: Median full-grid relative spectral power L1 error versus combined bits/value; this is not fraction of energy lost.

spectral_l2_rd.label: Relative spectral power L2
spectral_l2_rd.description: Median full-grid relative spectral power L2 error versus combined bits/value.

fourier_l2_rd.label: Relative Fourier L2
fourier_l2_rd.description: Median phase-sensitive relative Fourier L2 versus combined bits/value; Parseval links it to spatial L2.

field_acf_rd.label: Mean |Δ field ACF|
field_acf_rd.description: Median field ACF change averaged across axes and lags 1, 2, 4, 8, versus combined bits/value.

error_acf_rd.label: Mean |error ACF|
error_acf_rd.description: Median absolute error ACF averaged across axes and lags 1, 2, 4, 8. It is a diagnostic, not a universal distortion score.

cross_mean_rd.label: Mean |Δ cross-variable PCC|
cross_mean_rd.description: Mean absolute change across variable pairs versus bit rate combined over the participating variables.

cross_max_rd.label: Max |Δ cross-variable PCC|
cross_max_rd.description: Maximum absolute change across variable pairs versus bit rate combined over the participating variables.
